Soccavo, Pianura (Municipalità 9) — Naples, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Naples' western periphery, and the site of a long-running camorra territorial war between the Carillo and Esposito-Marsicano clans (based in Pianura) and the Vigilia and Grimaldi families (based in Soccavo). Police documented 22 significant violent incidents here between August 2022 and May 2024 alone — shootings, bombings, arson and murders — and a further anti-camorra operation on 25 November 2024 resulted in 15 suspects charged (13 jailed, 2 under house arrest) for mafia association, attempted murder, weapons offences, extortion and drug trafficking. Investigators describe the area as a neglected periphery living under a persistent climate of fear despite repeated crackdowns. Sources checked: Anteprima24.it, 25 Nov 2024 (Soccavo-Pianura camorra war, 15 arrests, incident count).
